text:
Eleanor: Thanks for coming to the all-hands — slides + recording here: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/jul-2024. Leaving a short follow-up thread for clarifications and owners.

Sam: Quick one on the Dedicated rollout window: in the talk you mentioned a gradual availability across regions. Is the plan to open us-west first and then eu-west? Any ETA? @Eleanor

Eleanor: Yes — US-west first (mid-Aug), EU-west follows ~3 weeks later. Exact dates depend on capacity validation. We'll update the calendar when infra confirms.

Maya: For Private GA: will customers be able to bring their own models, or only Redwood-verified images initially?

Eleanor: Private GA will support Redwood-verified images only. BYO-model support is planned for the post-GA patch (target Q4). We'll publish migration playbook.

Owen: Clarification on fallback policy: if Dedicated pool is saturated, does traffic automatically go to hosted compatible models or fail? Need to know for SLAs.

Eleanor: Default is to failover to a compatible hosted variant within the same region if allowed by customer policy. Customers can opt-out of automatic failover. We'll add policy flags in Console.

Diego: Action: I'll create the follow-ups tracker and include columns: owner, due, blocker. Sharing link in a sec.

all-hands-bot: Recording uploaded and transcript available: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/jul24.

Nina: Product ask: can we show per-model request success/failure rates in Console? Sales asked for that to help SRE conversations.

Eleanor: Good ask. Product + Eng will scope a lightweight metrics dashboard that surfaces success rate, p95 latency, and cost-per-1k-tokens. Action: Nina to lead mockups; Owen to confirm required telemetry.

Sam: Small follow-up on autoscale defaults: will the defaults prioritize latency or cost for new customers?

Owen: Defaults will favor latency for the first 30 days, then switch to cost-optimized recommendations unless customer overrides. We'll document the algorithm.

Diego: Follow-ups sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/1Followups-Jul. Shared with product, eng, sales.

Maya: Can we get a short FAQ for customers comparing Dedicated vs Private for compliance? Legal asked.

Eleanor: Marketing + Legal to co-author a 1-pager. Action: Maya to compile initial FAQ items; Eleanor to review.

Owen: Demo snippet we used in the all-hands for canary rollout:
```
rw rollout begin --pool dedicated-eu --model redwood-v3 --step 20%
```

Eleanor: Summary of owners: Diego (follow-ups sheet + owners), Nina (Console metrics mockups), Owen (telemetry/SLO docs + autoscale defaults), Maya (Private FAQ draft). Please update the sheet with status by EOD Thu. If blocked DM me.

Sam: Thanks — tagging product for visibility. :thumbsup:

Diego: Shared the sheet and added initial owners.

Eleanor: I'll send a short email recap and link the updated roadmap doc. Closing this thread; add any missed items to the sheet.
